Package com.bupt.ta.model

Class TaWorkloadStats

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.model.TaWorkloadStats
public class TaWorkloadStats extends Object
Per-TA application statistics and human-readable position summaries.

Aggregated in memory by WorkloadService from applications.json; not persisted as a separate entity. Accepted and rejected application lists hold one formatted line per matching Application.

Not thread-safe: mutable counters and lists are populated during a single request.

  • Method Details

    • formatAcceptedLine

      public static String formatAcceptedLine(Application application)
      Formats a single application as a compact summary line for workload displays.

      Layout: Module [code] - role | date. Missing parts are omitted; unknown module name becomes (Unknown module). Returns empty string for null application.

      Parameters:
      application - application to format, or null
      Returns:
      formatted line suitable for acceptedPositions or rejectedPositions
